summary.intent: Coordinate and report on parallel subagent work: a scripts cleanup (PR #431) and a condition-map memo perf optimization (PR #430), writing PR bodies and summarizing results for the user to decide on merging.
summary.outcome: PR #431 (deleted 16 unused scripts, added a 'no new script without a caller' rule) and PR #430 (condition-map memo, ChakraButton first answer 433 to 277 ms) both have bodies written and are awaiting user review. CI results were not seen on either, and #430 has an unresolved memory regression.

repo: origin/main is red: `cargo check --all-targets` fails because crates/core/tests/semantic_join.rs lacks fields added by #426; PR #429 fixes it and must merge first. `just lint` exits 101 only because of this.
AGENTS.md now has a 'Scripts' rule: no new script without a caller. docs/measurement.md lists each remaining script with its caller.

Kept scripts all have callers: weekly.py (plus corpora, headline, oracle_data, rdt.mjs, rdg.mjs, agent_eval.py, schema_version.py), bench.py (just bench), gate_fixtures.mjs (just gate-measure), verify-install.sh (CI Install job), check-packaging.mjs and napi-loader-version.mjs (lint and napi build).

Condition-map memo: `State::maps` in convert.rs is keyed (constraint handle, map symbol) per snapshot and holds only the property count. Reuse requires mapped flag, no alias/name, no `as` clause, no project-declared property/signature/index signature, and count above the budget (40 below a prop, 100 at top level). The unguarded first version changed MuiTextField output.
Documentation requests are already batched and cached by declaration since S7a, so no second cache was needed (ChakraButton batch: 2,548 sub-requests, 10-11 ms of about 210).

The tsrs 7.1 API lacks `getModifiersTypeOfMappedType`, so two instances of one unnamed generic map (`keyof T`) with identical keys beyond the budget but different declaring files could in principle differ. Aliased maps are never reused.
CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION was unchanged by the memo; recordings are against pinned tsrs 0.23.0-ts7.1.0-beta.

code.finding: Missing fields added by #426 break `cargo check --all-targets` on main; fixed by PR #429. Line numbers not given in the transcript.
Holds `State::maps` memo plus unit tests (including the signature guard case, which must be a unit test since a mapped type cannot have signatures). Line numbers not given.

workflow: When main is red, a worker can apply the fix PR's diff uncommitted for local checks and revert before committing, but this limits clean-room verification scope (here the semantic crate only, not the whole workspace).
Distinguish fix tests (fail on base) from guard tests (pass on base) in PR bodies; the memo PR does this explicitly.
Interleaved A/B runs under shared-machine load give noisy wall times; byte-identity comparisons against main were used as the correctness gate.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output without user authority; the PR body was written from the report, with unverified items listed explicitly.

friction: Shared machine load (19-43) made timing results noisy and the whole-run wall time inconclusive.
main being red forced local workarounds and narrowed the clean-room verification.
The whole-program peak RSS increase (+21 MiB tsrs, about 3.6%) on the memo branch is unexplained, while the gate required memory not be worse.
CI results for #430 and #431 were not seen; #431 is red only because of the main break.
